title: Made in India....
text: Made in India..... These came horribly tarnished and looking so bad I would be embarrassed to put these on my table.

product_metadata.title: Elegance Silver Hammered Napkin Ring, Set of 8
description: For over 30 years, Elegance has been known for elegant design at accessible prices. From home to hotel and everywhere in between, Elegance has made high end products that are used in fine hotels but affordable for the home as well. These napkin rings are no exception. With their elegant beaded design and solid, heavy feel, These napkin rings look and feel Bring affordable Elegance to your table.
